description: Prevention jobs watched by .github/workflows/prevention-watch.yml (plan step F3). mlai-backend has no scheduled prevention job, so the watch covers the CI checks that run on every push to main: a main branch whose checks stay red for stale_after_days alerts. cadence_days null means push-driven: only the red streak is checked. Add a scheduled prevention workflow here with its cadence_days when one is introduced. Override N with the PREVENTION_WATCH_STALE_DAYS repository variable.
